name: Belgian Open 2017
information:
The competitor entry fee is 20 euros and must be payed through the WCA payment system when you register. The entry fee for guests of 5 euros is payable at the competition. These fees include drinks/snacks/cake throughout both days.
The competitor limit is 100 people. If you register after this limit is reached you will be added to a waiting list. Registration will close at the end of Friday 10th November.
